## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, at the weak-breadth confirmation threshold; Financials and Industrials were both negative over 1W, while Consumer Staples and Utilities were positive and JNJ (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +10.56%) was ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5); sector breadth is in Internal Rotation, not Sector Weakness.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy led on the week: COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) and EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) were both in RECOVERY. Communication was next, with CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples also held up, with COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagged, with F (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -5.79%) BELOW TREND; Materials were weak, with FCX (1W: -11.46% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND. Technology also underperformed, led lower by NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) RECOVERY; CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND; EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY; COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4/5 sectors: Communication, Energy, Financials and Consumer Staples).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: RCL (1W: -5.69% | 1M: +14.46%) CORRECTION; ROST (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -5.87%) BELOW TREND; ETN (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -13.63%) BELOW TREND; F (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -5.79%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -38.26%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Consumer Discretionary, Industrials and Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves included CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND and CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: AMZN (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.10%) and HD (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +12.23%) are in CORRECTION, while COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) and EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) are in RECOVERY; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 2.56% over 1W and 8.94% over 1M; NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%), GOOGL (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -16.70%) and META (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -11.69%) are all BELOW TREND. Technology stock-level positive breadth was not supplied; the sector summary lists 24 constituents.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed: the sector fell 0.19% over 1W but gained 2.56% over 1M; CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%), AIG (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +2.49%) and V (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +6.12%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -0.44%) is BELOW TREND. Financials stock-level positive breadth was not supplied; the sector summary lists 20 constituents.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed: the sector fell 0.92% over 1W but gained 4.15% over 1M; JNJ (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +10.56%), UNH (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +2.64%) and LLY (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +14.03%) are ABOVE TREND, while PFE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -1.01%) is BELOW TREND. Healthcare stock-level positive breadth was not supplied; the sector summary lists 17 constituents.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to resilient Consumer Staples and relative-strength names such as COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to persistent Technology weakness such as NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed, with no clear Growth or Value leadership confirmed by breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND for continued Staples resilience and CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND for Financials follow-through. BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -38.26%) BELOW TREND for further Technology weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor Communication (+2.06% 1W; +4.62% 1M) and Consumer Staples (+1.72% 1W; +5.57% 1M); 4/11 sectors were positive overall. BEARISH: Technology (-2.56% 1W; -8.94% 1M) and Consumer Discretionary (-3.24% 1W; +4.51% 1M); stock-level sector breadth counts were not provided.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied; use trend confirmation triggers instead. Watch for NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND to stabilize, and for CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND to hold its weekly advance. Monitor AMZN (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.10%) in CORRECTION for a return to positive weekly momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
Among bullish-news names with price data supplied, ASML (+40): a Wall Street desk cited potential upside after a recent decline. ASML (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -14.19%) BELOW TREND; positive sentiment diverges from falling price, so follow-through is unconfirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
Among bearish-news names with price data supplied, AMZN (-45): the headline cited an AI-chip export rule and satellite-launch setback. AMZN (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.10%) CORRECTION; the negative news aligns with the weekly decline, though the 1M return remains positive.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with 4/11 sectors positive and no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership confirmed by breadth; Top 5 leadership was broad across 4 sectors. Relative strength includes CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND and COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND. Major 1W/1M divergences call for confirmation, while bearish news on AMZN (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.10%) in CORRECTION adds a near-term watchpoint.
